origin.description: strwrap_ctl that treats only SGR sequences as controls.
origin.usage: strwrap_sgr(x, width = 0.9 * getOption("width"), indent = 0, exdent = 0, prefix = "", simplify = TRUE, initial = prefix, warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), term.cap = getOption("fansi.term.cap", dflt_term_cap()), normalize = getOption("fansi.normalize", FALSE), carry = getOption("fansi.carry", FALSE), terminate = getOption("fansi.terminate", TRUE))
origin.details: strwrap_ctl that treats only SGR sequences as controls. An omitted wrap width is 72, which is 0.9 times the default R width of 80.

translation.description: strwrap_ctl that treats only SGR sequences as controls.
translation.usage: strwrap_sgr(x, width=None, indent=0, exdent=0, prefix="", simplify=True, initial=None, warn=None, term_cap=None, normalize=None, carry=None, terminate=None)
translation.details: strwrap_ctl that treats only SGR sequences as controls. An omitted wrap width is 72. A string is one element. None is a missing string. Dotted R names are written with underscores.
